faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Panjab University Guest Faculty (Law) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Panjab University Guest Faculty (Law) recruitment is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authorities before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Guest Faculty (Law) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) or equivalent and UGC-NET or Ph.D. in Law as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty (Law) position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Guest Faculty (Law) post in Panjab University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty (Law) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty (Law) post is Rs. 1500/- per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Guest Faculty (Law) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty (Law) post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Panjab University for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for this recruitment is ssgpurch.puchd.ac.in. You can find more details and download the application form from here.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant certificates along with the application form.
